summary: Frontend-only regression test of the Project Settings black-screen bug fix. Verified both entry paths (Home 3-dot button [aria-label='Configurações do projeto'] AND Workspace ws-settings-btn after sending a prompt) now open Project Settings with full content (Overview visible, no black screen, no fatal errors). All 10 sidebar sections (overview, models, github, integrations, security, design, deploy, environment, logs, advanced) render without crashing. Overview edit->save/discard dirty-state works correctly. Provider/Integration action buttons do not crash. Navigation back to workspace (open-project-btn) and home (st-home-btn) works. 100% of the 13 testable criteria PASS.

verification_details.home_3dot_to_settings: PASS - button[aria-label='Configurações do projeto'] opens [data-testid='project-settings'] with Overview visible (overview-name input present).
verification_details.home_prompt_workspace_settings: PASS - textarea.fill + button[aria-label='Enviar prompt'] -> ws-settings-btn -> project-settings loads fully.
verification_details.all_sidebar_sections: PASS - overview, models, github, integrations, security, design, deploy, environment, logs, advanced all render without unmounting the settings page.
verification_details.environment_add_var: PASS - env-add button click after filling KEY_NAME + value does not crash the page.
verification_details.overview_edit_dirty: PASS - save-btn/discard-btn disabled initially; after editing overview-name both enabled; discard restores original value.
verification_details.provider_integration_buttons: PASS - 4 provider-action-* and 4 int-action-* buttons click without crashing settings page.
verification_details.st_home_btn: PASS - returns to home (3-dot button visible again).

console_observations: Non-fatal PAGEERROR: ZodError observed during env-add action (likely schema validation of upsertEnvVar input). Does NOT cause black screen or unmount; page continues working. Main agent may want to surface a user-facing validation error instead of letting Zod throw.
action_items: Investigate the ZodError thrown during environment variable creation flow and either catch it to show a user-facing error or relax/align the schema with the form input (non-blocking, no visible impact today).
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectSettings.tsx contains two consecutive 'if (!settings)' branches (lines ~68 and ~99); the second is unreachable dead code. Safe to delete.
Hooks are now called before any early return - hooks-order bug correctly fixed.
renderSection() spreads a large baseProps object into every section; consider typing baseProps explicitly to keep type-safety and improve maintainability.
